[CHANGE] User's new last name is Thompson.  
[EVENT] User is trying to update their social media profiles with their new last name.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided a step-by-step guide for updating the last name on Facebook:  
[ASSISTANT] 1. Log in to Facebook.  
[ASSISTANT] 2. Click on the downward arrow in the top-right corner.  
[ASSISTANT] 3. Click on "Settings."  
[ASSISTANT] 4. Click on "Account Settings."  
[ASSISTANT] 5. Click on "Edit" next to "Name."  
[ASSISTANT] 6. Enter "Thompson" in the "Last Name" field.  
[ASSISTANT] 7. Enter Facebook password to confirm.  
[ASSISTANT] 8. Click "Save Changes."  
[ASSISTANT] Provided a step-by-step guide for updating the last name on Instagram:  
[ASSISTANT] 1. Open Instagram app.  
[ASSISTANT] 2. Tap the profile icon in the bottom-right corner.  
[ASSISTANT] 3. Tap the three horizontal lines (Settings) on the top-right corner.  
[ASSISTANT] 4. Tap "Account."  
[ASSISTANT] 5. Tap "Edit Profile."  
[ASSISTANT] 6. Edit last name to "Thompson."  
[ASSISTANT] 7. Tap "Done" to save changes.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided additional tips for Facebook and Instagram name changes.

[ASSISTANT] 7. Click "Save."
